en.title: Leave, Maternity and Basic Workplace Rights
en.directAnswer: Bangladesh labour law provides rights on matters such as leave, working conditions and maternity benefits for workers who fall within the relevant law. The exact amount of leave, eligibility and procedure depend on current amended sections and the worker’s status. Do not rely on an old HR blog.
